title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-10

ai_review.summary: Crisp matrix recording captures a high‑energy show with explosive Loser, smoking China Cat/China‑Rider, and a killer Sugar Magnolia guitar break.
ai_review.review: The upgraded 16/24‑bit matrix source is one of the clearest recordings on the Archive, delivering vivid detail that lets listeners hear Jerry’s “machine‑gun” solos and Brent’s inventive keyboards. The performance itself is a fire‑cracker – Loser and Looks Like Rain roar, China Cat/China‑Rider detonates, Cassidy jams wildly, and the crowd roars along to Sugar Magnolia and The Wheel.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 5‑star reviews praising both show energy and superb matrix sound quality; only one low rating, so overall rating is near‑exceptional.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the "crispest" and "superb" recording on the Archive; recent Seamons upgrades (16/24‑bit, re‑synced) eliminate dropouts and provide clear, balanced mix of band and audience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A dynamic set that builds momentum early with Loser and Looks Like Rain, peaks during the China Cat/China‑Rider sequence and Cassidy jam, and maintains high energy through Sugar Magnolia and The Wheel.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar tone is described as "machine‑gun" with full‑bodied, edgy solos; a standout break on Sugar Magnolia noted.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bombs away on the China/Rider segment, delivering powerful bass work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Engages the audience, getting sides of the crowd to sing “I CAN’T GET NO” and “Satisfaction”.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s creativity highlighted as a key element of the show’s brilliance.
